note: THE CANONICAL CHAT-HITL CAPTURE INDEX. One committed index and one shared recorder (scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-recorder.mjs) replace ad-hoc capture scripts, so a screenshot is never the only evidence. Every record carries the cell, the host it DECLARES, the kind and STATE it photographs, the URL the page actually ended on, the screenshot path with its sha256, and the frame-scoped selector assertions with the counts that were observed. No code path here turns supplied assertions into a record: observeCapture reads the page, and the old builder that stamped provenance onto assertions handed to it is gone. That is an API-surface fact, not provenance: a person editing this JSON can still copy the recorder id and invent counts, exactly as they can for any evidence file in the tree, and the recorder's header says so. scripts/audit/lib/chat-hitl-capture-driver.mjs is its production caller. The gate (scripts/audit/chat-hitl-acceptance-gate.mjs) validates schema, hashes, URL class, the required host anchors for the declared state and their counts, and binds every acceptance-manifest cell naming chat_thread to a record here. FILE NAMES CARRY NO AUTHORITY: a cell called `__chat_thread__` whose record ended on a run-detail URL, or whose chat anchors were never asserted, is a mislabeled capture and fails. A PENDING capture owes its decision controls; a SETTLED one owes their absence and its own decided summary. WHY records IS EMPTY, stated exactly rather than left to look like neglect: the two chat_thread cells the acceptance manifest cites (C1/C2 in evidence/2573-s7-visuals-lane) were photographed by an earlier capture run whose own recorded results are committed beside them. That run observed three of the four required anchors: the /chat URL class, data-lifecycle-card-host=chat_thread, and the card root, with the pending and settled states respectively. It never looked for [data-conversation-list]. A record asserting a count for an anchor nobody measured is the fabrication this index exists to refuse, so those cells stay unbound and the gate stays honestly red until they are re-captured through the driver. That is one command against a running app; it is not a code change.
